title: DNS lookup
description: Resolve a host's A, AAAA, MX, TXT and NS records. A good first look at a domain before WHOIS, mail config or certificate searches.

title: Reverse DNS
description: Find the hostnames that an IP address points back to (PTR records). The names alone do not show who owns the IP or which sites share it.

title: IP lookup
description: Find the network (ASN) behind an IP address and the country it was registered in, via Team Cymru. The registration country is not where the server is.

title: ipctl IP lookup
description: Find the network behind an IP address: its ASN, routed prefix and RPKI status, with geolocation shown separately.

title: IPinfo lookup
description: Get the city, region, country and network name for an IP address. Location and network name are labels, not proof of who runs the server.

title: WHOIS lookup
description: Look up a domain's registration record over RDAP: registrar, key dates and nameservers.

title: WhoisXML lookup
description: Look up a domain's registration record through WhoisXML. Use it when the RDAP record is thin.

title: Whoxy lookup
description: Look up a domain's live registration record through Whoxy, a second source alongside WhoisXML.

title: Certificate transparency
description: Find subdomains and other hostnames in public certificate logs, via crt.sh. The main way to discover subdomains without touching the target.

title: Cert Spotter
description: Find certificates issued for a domain, via Cert Spotter. A second certificate-log source alongside crt.sh.

title: C99 subdomain finder
description: Find subdomains of a domain through C99's subdomain finder. One source, not a combined search across many.

title: HackerTarget reverse IP
description: List other domains hosted on the same IP address, via HackerTarget. A quick way to spot shared hosting.

title: Mnemonic PassiveDNS
description: See which IP addresses a domain has resolved to over time, or which domains an IP has served, via mnemonic's passive DNS. Past resolutions do not show ownership.

title: URLScan search
description: Search urlscan.io's past public scans of a domain for snapshots of how its pages looked and behaved. Does not start a new scan.

title: URLScan submit
description: Ask urlscan.io to load a URL in a browser now and record what it does. Scans are unlisted by default, because a public scan can reveal what you are investigating.

title: Mail config
description: Check how a domain says its mail should be authenticated: MX, SPF, DMARC and common DKIM selectors.

title: TXT inventory
description: Sort a domain's TXT records into verification tokens, SaaS accounts and mail settings, showing which services have claimed the domain.

title: TLS audit
description: Connect to a host over TLS (port 443 by default) and record the protocol, the certificate's subject and issuer, and whether it validates.

title: HTTP surface
description: Request a host's web server and record its security headers, security.txt, favicon hash and any CDN or firewall in front of it.

title: Shodan lookup
description: See what Shodan's internet-wide scans found on an IP address: open ports, service banners and hostnames.

title: Censys lookup
description: See what Censys's internet-wide scans found on an IP address: services, certificates and location. A different scan source from Shodan.

title: LeakIX lookup
description: See what LeakIX has found exposed on an IP address or host: open services, misconfigurations and published leaks.

title: Tor exit-node check
description: Check whether an IP address is currently on the Tor Project's list of exit nodes.

title: Tranco top-sites rank
description: Get a domain's rank in the Tranco list of popular sites. A measure of popularity only, not of ownership or intent.

title: Enrich URL
description: Fetch a URL now, preferring a Markdown copy, and collect its Wayback history. Other Caps turn the results into Proposals.

title: Wayback history
description: List the dates the Wayback Machine captured a URL. Start here to learn whether a page existed at a given time.

title: Wayback fetch
description: Fetch a page as the Wayback Machine captured it, at a given time or the nearest capture. Shows what the page actually said then.

title: Submit to archives
description: Ask the Wayback Machine to capture a URL now. This creates a public record of the capture, so use it only when you need a fresh public snapshot.

title: Common Crawl
description: Search recent Common Crawl indexes for URLs on a domain. A different archive from the Wayback Machine, useful when it has little.

title: Unshorten URL
description: Follow a short link's redirects and record every hop, ending at the real destination.

title: Page enrich
description: Fetch a page now and record its title, social and meta tags, and any common tracking scripts.

title: Media oEmbed
description: Get the public author name and link for a media URL from YouTube, Vimeo, Flickr, SoundCloud, TikTok or Spotify, without scraping the page.

title: Email lookup
description: Check the mail setup of an email address's domain (MX, SPF and DMARC) and guess its mail provider. Lighter than a full mail config check.

title: EmailRep lookup
description: Get a reputation score for an email address, such as whether it is disposable or has appeared near breaches. Context only, not proof of who owns it.

title: PGP lookup
description: Search public PGP keyservers by email address, fingerprint or key ID to link a mailbox to a published key.

title: GitHub lookup
description: Get a GitHub user's public profile: display name, bio and account details.

title: Keybase lookup
description: Look up a Keybase user or domain to see the accounts and keys they have proven they control.

title: Gravatar lookup
description: Check whether an email address has a public Gravatar profile, and get its avatar and display name if it does.

title: HIBP lookup

attribution.text: Data from Have I Been Pwned

description: Check Have I Been Pwned for the breaches an email address appeared in. A hit means the address was in a breach, not that the same person controls it today.

title: Hudson Rock lookup
description: Check Hudson Rock for infostealer infections tied to an email address, IP address or domain: how many and the most recent date. No passwords or cookies are returned.

title: DeHashed lookup

query.description: Email, IP, domain, username, or freeform query
Email, IP, domain, username, or freeform query

description: Search DeHashed's breach data by email address, IP address, domain, username or free text. Results can include passwords and password hashes; a capped sample is kept as Evidence.

title: Snusbase lookup
description: Search Snusbase's breach and combolist data by email address, IP address, domain or username. Results can include passwords and password hashes; a capped sample is kept as Evidence.

title: VirusTotal lookup
description: Get VirusTotal's verdicts from many security vendors for an IP address or domain. A reputation signal, not proof of identity.

title: AbuseIPDB lookup
description: Get AbuseIPDB's community abuse reports and confidence score for an IP address. A reputation signal, not proof of ownership or malice.

title: ThreatFox lookup
description: Check ThreatFox for malware command servers and payloads tied to an IP address or domain.

title: URLhaus lookup
description: Check whether URLhaus lists a URL, host or file hash as a malware distribution site or sample.

title: MalwareBazaar lookup
description: Get MalwareBazaar's details for a file hash: malware family, signature and tags. Does not download the sample.

title: Feodo Tracker lookup
description: Check whether an IP address is on Feodo Tracker's blocklist of botnet command servers, such as Emotet, Dridex and QakBot.

title: GreyNoise Community
description: Check whether GreyNoise sees an IP address as background internet scanning or a known harmless service, to tell routine noise from targeted traffic.

title: CIRCL hashlookup

hash.description: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, or SHA-512 hex hash
MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, or SHA-512 hex hash

description: Check whether a file hash is in CIRCL's library of known software. A hit means the file is known, not that it is safe.

title: CIRCL BGP Ranking
description: Get CIRCL's rank of how much malicious activity comes from the network (ASN) behind an IP address.

title: SANS ISC DShield

attribution.text: DShield / SANS Internet Storm Center (data licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

description: See how often SANS ISC's DShield sensors have recorded an IP address attacking them.

title: Team Cymru Malware Hash Registry

hash.description: MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256 hex hash
MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256 hex hash

description: Check Team Cymru's Malware Hash Registry for a file hash: when it was last seen and what share of antivirus engines detect it.

title: FireHOL level1 blocklist
description: Check whether an IP address is on the FireHOL level 1 blocklist, which combines several well-known blocklists.

title: OTX lookup

query.description: IP, domain, URL, or file hash
IP, domain, URL, or file hash

description: Check AlienVault OTX for community reports and malware families tied to an IP address, domain, URL or file hash.

title: Google Safe Browsing lookup
description: Check whether Google Safe Browsing lists a URL as malware, phishing or unwanted software.

title: IBM X-Force Exchange lookup

query.description: IP, domain, URL, or file hash
IP, domain, URL, or file hash

description: Get IBM X-Force Exchange's reputation and malware counts for an IP address, URL or file hash.

title: GreedyBear scanner feed
description: Check whether an IP address or domain appears in GreedyBear's feed of scanners its honeypots saw in the last three days or so.

title: HoneyDB lookup
description: Get HoneyDB's honeypot history for an IP address: whether its sensors saw it attack, and any threat lists it is on.

title: Harvest Evidence
description: Pull identifiers such as email addresses, domains and IPs out of Evidence text with fixed patterns. Fast, and a first pass before AI extraction.

title: Extract Evidence (AI)
description: Use AI to pull identifiers, claims and open questions out of Evidence text, when the pattern-based harvest misses too much.

title: Analyze file
description: Inspect a file held as Evidence: its type, basic metadata, readable text and SHA-256 hash, drafted as findings for Triage.

title: Analyze EML
description: Read a saved email (.eml) held as Evidence: its headers, the servers it passed through, and the email addresses and URLs inside, for Triage.
